name: Country Subdivision Identification
definition: Identification code and name to identify a name of a unit resulting from the division of a country, dependency, or other area of special geopolitical interest contained in ISO 3166-1, on the basis of country names obtained from the United Nations (ISO 3166-2: Country subdivision code).

Code.definition: Code to identify a name of a unit resulting from the division of a country, dependency, or other area of special geopolitical interest contained in ISO 3166-1, on the basis of country names obtained from the United Nations (ISO 3166-2: Country subdivision code).
